```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
con = DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../data/midwest_airbnb_extended.db")
listings     = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "listings") |> tibble::as_tibble()
availability = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "availability_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
reviews      = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "reviews_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
```



#1
```{r}
host_counts = listings |>
  dplyr::count(host_id, name = "host_listings")

host_counts |>
  dplyr::filter(host_listings >= 10) |>
  dplyr::summarize(n_hosts = dplyr::n())

listings_hosts = listings |>
  dplyr::left_join(host_counts, by = "host_id")

listings_hosts |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(pct_big_hosts = 100 * mean(host_listings >= 10))
```

#2
```{r}
listings |>
  dplyr::filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt",
                accommodates >= 4,
                number_of_reviews >= 10,
                review_scores_rating >= 4.8) |>
  dplyr::mutate(price_per_person = price / accommodates) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, neighbourhood) |>
  dplyr::summarize(median_ppp = median(price_per_person, na.rm = TRUE),
                   n = dplyr::n(),
                   .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::filter(n >= 20, city == "Columbus") |>
  dplyr::arrange(median_ppp)
```
#3
```{r}
listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, room_type) |>
  dplyr::summarize(dplyr::across(c(price, reviews_per_month, estimated_revenue_l365d), ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),.groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::select(city, room_type, estimated_revenue_l365d)
```
#4
```{r}
listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(estimated_revenue_l365d), .by_group = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(top10 = dplyr::row_number() <= ceiling(0.10 * dplyr::n())) |>
  dplyr::summarize(pct_top10 = 100 * sum(estimated_revenue_l365d[top10], na.rm = TRUE) /
                     sum(estimated_revenue_l365d, na.rm = TRUE))
```
#5
```{r}
entire = listings |>
  dplyr::filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt") |>
  dplyr::select(id, city)

availability |>
  dplyr::filter(month == "2026-10") |>
  dplyr::inner_join(entire, by = "id") |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(pct_mostly_taken = 100 * mean(nights_available < 0.5 * nights_in_month))
```
#6
```{r}
monthly = reviews |>
  dplyr::inner_join(dplyr::select(listings, id, city), by = "id") |>
  dplyr::filter(month >= "2025-07", month <= "2026-06") |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, month) |>
  dplyr::summarize(total_reviews = sum(reviews), .groups = "drop")

monthly |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Twin Cities") |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(total_reviews))

monthly |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Twin Cities") |>
  dplyr::summarize(ratio = max(total_reviews) / min(total_reviews))
```
#7
```{r}
superhost = listings |>
  dplyr::filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt",
                host_is_superhost %in% c("t", "f"))

superhost |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, host_is_superhost) |>
  dplyr::summarize(median_price = median(price, na.rm = TRUE),
                   median_rating = median(review_scores_rating, na.rm = TRUE),.groups = "drop")

superhost |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(premium = median(price[host_is_superhost == "t"], na.rm = TRUE) - median(price[host_is_superhost == "f"], na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
missing = listings |>
  dplyr::anti_join(availability, by = "id")

missing |>
  dplyr::summarize(n_missing = dplyr::n())

missing |>
  dplyr::count(city)
```
